en.headline: Italy-Hong Kong menswear show opens today at Fashion Walk
en.dek: Future Threads gathers ten emerging designers from Hong Kong and Italy at a free Causeway Bay exhibition running through 13 September.

zh.headline: 意港男裝展今起銅鑼灣Fashion Walk免費開放
zh.dek: 香港設計中心聯同意大利國家時裝商會舉辦的「共織新意」今日至9月13日在銅鑼灣展出十個新銳男裝品牌。

en.headline: Hong Kong PMI slips to 49.5 in August after three-month rise
en.dek: The S&P Global Hong Kong SAR PMI fell below the 50 mark, pointing to a renewed contraction in private-sector conditions after July's reading of 51.0.

zh.headline: 8月香港PMI回落至49.5 連升三個月後再收縮
zh.dek: 標普全球香港特區採購經理指數由7月的51.0跌至49.5，顯示私營部門營商環境在連續三個月擴張後再度轉差。

en.headline: Lee attends City Hall ceremony marking victory over Japan
en.dek: The official commemoration of the 81st anniversary of victory in the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression was held at 8am at the Hong Kong City Hall Memorial Garden.

zh.headline: 抗戰勝利81周年 李家超出席大會堂紀念儀式
zh.dek: 特區政府今早8時在香港大會堂紀念花園舉行官方儀式，紀念中國人民抗日戰爭暨世界反法西斯戰爭勝利81周年。

en.headline: Cafe Landmark set to reopen Friday at Landmark Atrium
en.dek: The first-floor balcony restaurant in Central, closed since early July for renovation, returns on 4 September after more than two decades on the atrium.

zh.headline: 置地廣場Cafe Landmark周五重開
zh.dek: 中環置地廣場中庭一樓露台餐廳総初因翻新停業，營運商美心集團早前確認保留原名，定於9月4日重新開業。

en.headline: MTR receives four bids for Tuen Mun Area 16 Phase 2
en.dek: Tendering closed on Wednesday for the large railway-topside scheme beside the future Tuen Mun South Extension station, with results to be announced later.

zh.headline: 港鐵屯門第16區站第二期收四份標書
zh.dek: 毗鄰興建中屯門南延絲第16區站的大型上蓋項目周三截標，港鐵稱稍後公布結果，市場估計項目可提供約5,510伙。

en.headline: DH and police arrest two after seizing unregistered injections
en.dek: Health officials said more than 50 suspected unregistered injections were taken from over 13 premises in a joint operation tied to advertised multi-cancer WT1 shots.

zh.headline: 衞生署聯同警方拘兩人 檢逾50支未註冊針劑
zh.dek: 衞生署表示，就有醫療中心宣傳可預防多種癌症的WT1針劑，聯同警方搜查逾13個處所，檢獲50多支懸疑未經註冊注射劑，兩人被捕。

en.headline: Saudel makes landfall in Fujian; Signal No. 1 stays today
en.dek: The Observatory said Tropical Storm Saudel had made landfall over Zhangzhou and at 8am was about 370 kilometres east-northeast of Hong Kong, with Signal No. 1 remaining in force.

zh.headline: 沙德爾登陸漳州 一號戒備信號今日維持
zh.dek: 天文台早上7時45分公布，熱帶風暴沙德爾已登陸福建漳州，上午8時位於本港東北偏東約370公里，一號戒備信號繼續生效。

en.headline: Yu Lan Cultural Festival opens Friday at Victoria Park
en.dek: The Chiu Chow clansmen’s association stages three free days at Soccer Pitch 1 from 10am to 9pm, with ghost-grabbing contests on Saturday and Sunday.

zh.headline: 皿蘭文化節周五起在維園舉行 免費入場至周日
zh.dek: 香港潮屬社團總會周五至周日於銅鑼灣維多利亞公園一號足球場舉辦第九屆皿蘭文化節，上午10時至晚上9時，設搶孤及盆供比賽。

en.headline: Education Bureau steps in after rain queues for school uniform checks
en.dek: Officials reminded two schools to consider students’ needs after first-day inspections left pupils waiting outside in the rain or kept on campus over hair rules.

zh.headline: 開學日冒雨查儀容 教育局提醒學校顧及學生需要
zh.dek: 九龍塘學校中學部被指開學日在校外排隊檢查校服，何文田鄧鏡波中學則有約300名學生因頭髮被指過長留校，教育局已聯絡兩校跟進。

en.headline: Veteran actor and dancer Lau Siu-ming dies at 94
en.dek: Friend and actor Ding Yu said Ming Sir died on Wednesday evening; Culture Secretary Rosanna Law praised his work in dance and film.

zh.headline: 資深演員及舞蹈家劉兆銘逝世 享年94歲
zh.dek: 藝人丁羽證實Ming Sir周三傍晚離世；文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩向其家人致哀，稱會銘記他的才華與奉獻。

en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 stays; Saudel 410 km east-northeast at 5am
en.dek: Tropical Storm Saudel was estimated near 23.5 degrees north, 117.9 degrees east early Thursday and is forecast to linger over the northeastern South China Sea before turning west.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號早上維持 沙德爾5時位於東北偏東約410公里
zh.dek: 熱帶風暴沙德爾周四早上在南海東北部掕徊，天文台指一號戒備信號今早維持，稍後評估周五靠近珠江口時會否改發三號強風信號。

en.headline: Sui-Tang civilisation exhibition continues at History Museum
en.dek: More than 165 artefacts from Shaanxi, including 18 national first-class cultural relics, remain on show at the Hong Kong Museum of History until 30 November under the title Chang’an Myriad Vistas.

zh.headline: 歷史博物館隋唐文明展繼續展出至11月底
zh.dek: 「長安萬象—陝西隋唐文明展」展出逾165件（套）文物，包括18件國家一級文物，免費入場，展期至11月30日。

en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 remains; Saudel about 400 km east-northeast
en.dek: Tropical Storm Saudel was estimated near 23.1 degrees north, 118.0 degrees east early Thursday and is forecast to linger over the northeastern South China Sea before turning westwards.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號維持 沙德爾位於本港東北偏東約400公里
zh.dek: 熱帶風暴沙德爾周四凌晨位於北緯23.1度、東經118.0度附近，預料在南海東北部徘徊後逐漸轉西，掠過廣東東部沿岸。

en.headline: HKJC postpones Conghua racing debut; reports record HK$331.7 billion turnover
en.dek: The planned 31 October launch of regular racing at the Guangzhou track is delayed after a latest risk assessment from mainland departments; the Club also reported strong results for the year ended 30 June.

zh.headline: 馬會延期從化馬場開跑 年度投注額創3317億元新高
zh.dek: 原定10月31日啟動常規賽馬因內地最新風險評估延期；馬會公布截至6月30日止財政年度業績，博彩及獎券投注總額按年升3.6%。

en.headline: CHP investigates two confirmed Mpox cases, urges high-risk groups to vaccinate
en.dek: A 38-year-old man and a 34-year-old man tested positive; both had high-risk exposure in Hong Kong during the incubation period and are in stable condition under isolation.

zh.headline: 防護中心調查兩宗猴痘確診 籲高風險群組接種疫苗
zh.dek: 38歲及34歲男病人分別確診，潛伏期內均在港有高風險接觸，現於醫院隔離治療，情況穩定。

en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 stays; Saudel 380 km east at 11pm
en.dek: Tropical Storm Saudel was estimated about 380 kilometres east of Hong Kong at 11pm and is forecast to linger over the northeastern South China Sea on Thursday morning before turning westwards.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號維持 沙德爾晚上11時位於本港以東約380公里
zh.dek: 熱帶風暴沙德爾晚上11時位於本港以東約380公里，預料周四早上在南海東北部徘徊，其後逐漸轉西掠過廣東東部沿岸。

en.headline: National Day fireworks set for 1 October over Victoria Harbour
en.dek: A 23-minute display of about 31,888 shells will begin at 8pm under the theme Eternal Radiance, marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People’s Republic of China.

zh.headline: 國慶煙花匯演10月1日晚上8時維港上演
zh.dek: 為慶祝中華人民共和國成立77周年，約31888枚煙花分八幕燃放23分鐘，主題為「永明煙花 綻放中華」。

en.headline: Customs bust etomidate lab in Kam Tin, seize HK$42 million haul
en.dek: A 61-year-old man was arrested after officers found a semi-automated production line and materials capable of making more than 160,000 capsules at a village house.

zh.headline: 海關錦田村屋搗依托咪酯工場 檢市值約4200萬元拘一男
zh.dek: 61歲男子被控製造及販運危險藥物，單位內設半自動化生產線，原材料可短時間製逾16萬粒煙彈。

en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 stays overnight; Saudel 350 km east at 8pm
en.dek: Tropical Storm Saudel was centred about 350 kilometres east of Hong Kong at 8pm and is expected to linger over the northeastern South China Sea through Thursday morning.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號通宵維持 沙德爾晚上8時位於本港以東約350公里
zh.dek: 熱帶風暴沙德爾晚上8時位於本港以東約350公里，預料今晚至周四早上在南海東北部徘徊，與本港保持約300公里或以上距離。

en.headline: Two school buses collide in Ngau Chi Wan; 13 injured including children
en.dek: A white school bus carrying kindergarten pupils hit a parked yellow school bus outside a school on Jat Shan Road shortly after 1.20pm; all injuries were reported as minor.

zh.headline: 牛池灣扎山道兩校巴相撞 約13人輕傷包括學童
zh.dek: 白色校巴載有幼稚園學童疑失控撞向停泊的黃色校巴，司機腳部一度被困，全部傷者輕傷送院。

en.headline: CityU probes orientation ‘disco night’ video, vows zero tolerance
en.dek: The university set up a student discipline panel after a social-media clip appeared to show intimate behaviour among people believed to be students at a Management Sciences Society event.

zh.headline: 城大調查迎新「Disco Night」短片 強調零容忍不當行為
zh.dek: 社交平台流傳疑似管理科學學科聯會迎新活動短片後，城大成立紀律調查委員會，稱對損害學生尊嚴的行為絕不容忍。

en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 stays; Saudel 330 km east at 3pm
en.dek: Tropical Storm Saudel was centred about 330 kilometres east of Hong Kong at 3pm and is forecast to move northeast at about 10 km/h across the northeastern South China Sea.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號維持 沙德爾下午3時位於本港以東約330公里
zh.dek: 熱帶風暴沙德爾下午3時位於本港以東約330公里，預料向東北移動，時速約10公里，橫過南海東北部。

en.headline: Joshua Wong pleads guilty to foreign collusion charge
en.dek: The 29-year-old activist, already serving a subversion sentence, admitted conspiracy to collude with foreign forces at the High Court on Wednesday.

zh.headline: 黃之鋒承認串謀勾結外國勢力罪
zh.dek: 29歲的黃之鋒周三在高等法院承認一項串謀勾結外國勢力罪，他目前仍在服顛覆國家政權罪刑期。

en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 stays; Saudel 310 km east at 1pm
en.dek: Tropical Storm Saudel was centred about 310 kilometres east of Hong Kong at 1pm and is forecast to move northeast at about 10 km/h across the northeastern South China Sea.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號維持 沙德爾下午1時位於本港以東約310公里
zh.dek: 熱帶風暴沙德爾下午1時位於本港以東約310公里，預料向東北移動，時速約10公里，橫過南海東北部。

en.headline: Government launches third InnoHK platform with HK$2.5 billion
en.dek: SEAM@InnoHK opened at the Science Park on Tuesday with eight research centres focused on sustainability, energy, advanced manufacturing and new materials.

zh.headline: 第三個InnoHK研發平台啟動 政府撥款約25億元
zh.dek: SEAM@InnoHK周二於科學園開幕，八所研發中心聚焦可持續發展、能源、先進製造及新材料，夥約30個海內外機構。

en.headline: HKU Shanghai campus takes more than 300 students this term
en.dek: Phase two of the Zhangjiang base is in use for the new academic year, with dual-city computing programmes and planned labs with technology firms.

zh.headline: 港大上海張江校園本學期逾300名學生上課
zh.dek: 張江基地二期3號及5號樓已投入新學年使用，計算與數據科學學院推行港滬雙校區課程，並與多家科技企業合作。

en.headline: More than 34,000 subdivided units registered as early-bird window closes
en.dek: The first six-month fee-waiver phase under the Basic Housing Units Ordinance ended on Monday; a second registration window runs until 28 February 2027.

zh.headline: 簡樸房早鳥登記截止 逾3.4萬個分間單位已登記
zh.dek: 首輪全額寬免認證費優惠已於周一結束；第二輪登記即日至2027年2月28日，寬免幅度較首輪減少。

en.headline: Observatory to assess Strong Wind Signal as Saudel may turn west
en.dek: Tropical Storm Saudel was about 300 kilometres east-southeast of Hong Kong at 10am; the Observatory said it may near the Pearl River Estuary around Friday and Saturday.

zh.headline: 天文台：沙德爾周五至周六或再近珠江口 稍後評估三號波
zh.dek: 熱帶風暴沙德爾上午10時位於本港東南偏東約300公里；天文台指一號戒備信號料維持至今日完結，稍後評估是否改發三號強風信號。

en.headline: The Gruffalo returns to the Academy this weekend
en.dek: Tall Stories’ hour-long English musical of the Julia Donaldson picture book plays the Rita Tong Liu Drama Theatre from Friday, with a second run the following weekend.

zh.headline: 繪本音樂劇《咕嚎牛》本周末起在演藝學院上演
zh.dek: 英國Tall Stories改編自朱莉婕・唐納森繪本的英語音樂劇，周五起在灣仔演藝學院麗瑞楠戲劇院演出，每場約60分鐘。

en.headline: Hong Kong firms pledge tens of millions for Tibet landslide relief
en.dek: CK Asset, CK Hutchison, Henderson Land and Sino Group each said they would give 15 million yuan through the Liaison Office disaster-relief account.

zh.headline: 港商再向西藏吉隆泥石流災區捐款 長實恒地等各捐人民幣1500萬
zh.dek: 長實、長和、李嘉誠基金會，以及恒地與李兆基基金，分別經中聯辦贁災帳戶捐出人民幣1500萬元。

en.headline: Health chief says drug and device regulator to be set up this year
en.dek: Lo Chung-mau said the new centre would support first-tier local approval of innovative medicines, with a target of full review capacity by 2030.

zh.headline: 盧寵茂：年內成立藥械監督管理中心 盼2030年全面審批新藥
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局局長接受專訪時表示，香港將於今年內成立藥物及醫療器械監督管理中心，目標2030年可全面審批創新藥物。

en.headline: HKU medicine changes MBBS language bar from Cantonese to Chinese
en.dek: The faculty said 2027/28 applicants may meet the Chinese requirement in Cantonese or Putonghua, but Cantonese is still required before clinical work.

zh.headline: 港大醫科入學語言改為良好中文 院方：實習前仍須粵語
zh.dek: 港大醫學院更新2027/28年度招生資料，中文要求改為粵語或普通話均可，但強調接觸病人前必須具備粵語溝通能力。

en.headline: National Ecology Day exhibition opens at East Kowloon Cultural Centre
en.dek: The Countryside Conservation Office is staging a free show at The Corner until 6 September, with displays on Mirs Bay, conservation and village life.

zh.headline: 全國生態日專題展於東九文化中心展隅免費開放
zh.dek: 鄉郊保育辦事處展覽舉行至9月6日，以大鵬灣、自然保育及鄉村故事為主題，開放時間上午11時至晚上8時。

en.headline: Wildlife Photographer of the Year closes today at Science Museum
en.dek: The Hong Kong Science Museum’s special exhibition of winning images from the London Natural History Museum contest ends on Wednesday, a free-admission day.

zh.headline: 科學館野外生態攝影年展今日結束 周三常設展免費入場
zh.dek: 香港科學館展出倫敦自然歷史博物館第61屆野外生態攝影大賽得獎作品，展期至9月2日，入場已包括在常設展覽票價內。

en.headline: Customs smash four illicit cigarette stores, seize HK$20 million haul
en.dek: Raids in San Tin, Tsuen Wan and North Point on Tuesday netted about 4.25 million untaxed cigarettes and four arrests, officers said.

zh.headline: 海關破四個私煙倉檢425萬支煙 市值約2,000萬拙4人
zh.dek: 人員周二在新田、荃灣及北角採取行動，檢獲約425萬支懷疑未完稅香煙，拘4名男子。

en.headline: Police raid Tai Po flat used as gambling den, arrest 32
en.dek: Tai Po officers searched a Kwong Fuk Road unit on Tuesday evening, seized six mahjong tables and charged two men with operating a gambling establishment.

zh.headline: 大埔廣福道住宅疑作賭檔 警拓32人最年長91歲
zh.dek: 大埔警區人員周二傍晚搜查廣福道一個單位，檢獲6張麻雀枱，兩名男子被控經營賭博場所。

en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 stays in force as Saudel tracks east-southeast
en.dek: Tropical Storm Saudel was about 280 kilometres east-southeast of Hong Kong at 6am; the Observatory said the chance of a Strong Wind Signal remains relatively low.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號早上維持 沙德爾位於東南偏東約280公里
zh.dek: 熱帶風暴沙德爾上午6時位於本港東南偏東約280公里；天文台指今明兩日改發三號強風信號機會仍相對較低。

en.headline: Contemporary Fujian restaurant Quan opens in Central
en.dek: Chef Justin Yang’s new tasting-menu restaurant on the fifth floor of CCB Tower focuses on Fujian traditions through a modern lens, with dishes built around the five elements.

zh.headline: 中環新餐廳Quan主打現代福建菜
zh.dek: 主廚Justin Yang於中銀大廈五樓開設以福建傳統為本的試菜餐廳，菜單按五行結構設計。

en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 remains; Saudel now a tropical storm
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said Tropical Storm Saudel was about 250 km east-southeast of the territory early Wednesday and the chance of a Strong Wind Signal stays relatively low.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號維持 沙德爾已增強為熱帶風暴
zh.dek: 天文台表示，熱帶風暴沙德爾周三凌晨位於本港東南偏東約250公里，改發三號強風信號機會仍相對較低。

en.headline: CENTRESTAGE fashion fair opens today at the Convention Centre
en.dek: About 270 brands from 24 countries and regions are taking part in the four-day event, which features more than 30 fashion shows and is free for trade and public visitors aged 18 or above.

zh.headline: 香港國際時尚匯展今日於會展開幕
zh.dek: 約270個品牌來自24個國家及地區參與為期四天的展覽，設逾30場時裝表演，18歲或以上業內及公眾人士免費入場。

en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 remains in force as Saudel edges closer
en.dek: Tropical Storm Saudel was about 250 kilometres east-southeast of Hong Kong early Wednesday; the Observatory said the chance of a Strong Wind Signal remains relatively low.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號繼續生效 沙德爾靠近粵東沿岸
zh.dek: 熱帶風暴沙德爾周三凌晨位於本港東南偏東約250公里；天文台指改發三號強風信號機會仍相對較低。

en.headline: Five-year-old with chronic illness in serious condition after influenza A
en.dek: The boy developed fever, cough and shortness of breath on Sunday and is being treated in the paediatric intensive care unit at Queen Mary Hospital.

zh.headline: 5歲長期病患男童染甲流併發嚴重肺炎 情況嚴重
zh.dek: 男童周日起發燒咳嗽氣促，現於瑪麗醫院兒童深切治療部留醫；防護中心料開學初期流感仍活躍。

en.headline: Tram services suspended between Admiralty and Johnston Road after power fault
en.dek: Both eastbound and westbound services on the section were halted from about 9.40pm; the Transport Department advised passengers to use alternative routes.

zh.headline: 金鐘至杜老誌道電車因電力故障暫停服務
zh.dek: 運輸署晚上約9時43分接獲通知，東西行線電車均暫停；工程人員正搶修，乘客需改用其他交通工具。

en.headline: Public schools cut record 126 Primary One classes for new school year
en.dek: The latest Primary School Profiles show a net drop of 8 per cent; Kwai Tsing lost the most classes, followed by Tuen Mun and Eastern district.

zh.headline: 今學年小一淨減126班創紀錄 葵青成縮班重災區
zh.dek: 《小學概覽2026》顯示官津小學小一班數按年跌約8%；121間學校合共縮144班，15間學校派零班。

en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 to remain overnight and into Wednesday morning
en.dek: Tropical Depression Saudel was about 240 km southeast of Hong Kong at 9pm; the Observatory said the chance of a Strong Wind Signal remains relatively low.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號今晚及明早維持 沙德爾繼續靠近粵東
zh.dek: 熱帶低氣壓沙德爾晚上9時位於本港東南約240公里；天文台指今明兩日改發三號強風信號機會仍相對較低。

en.headline: Customs seize 6.4 kg of ketamine; two secondary students arrested
en.dek: The drugs were hidden inside garden lamp posts in an air parcel from Belgium; the 13- and 14-year-old boys were due to start Secondary Two on Tuesday.

zh.headline: 海關檢6.4公斤氯胺酮 拘兩名中二生
zh.dek: 毒品藏於比利時空運園林燈柱包裹內；13歲及14歲男童原定周二開學升讀中二。

en.headline: Online platform Neigbuy data breach may affect more than 33,000 users
en.dek: The Privacy Commissioner’s Office is investigating after the company reported a suspected cyber attack last month; police recorded six related scam cases involving over HK$300,000.

zh.headline: 網購平台「鄰住買」資料外洩或影響逾3.3萬人
zh.dek: 私隱專員公署正調查平台上月疑遭網絡攻擊；警方錄得六宗假冒客服騙案，涉款逾30萬元。

en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 stays in force; Thunderstorm Warning until 10pm
en.dek: Tropical Depression Saudel was about 240 km southeast of Hong Kong at 8pm; the Observatory said the chance of a Strong Wind Signal remains relatively low.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號繼續生效 雷暴警告至晚上10時
zh.dek: 熱帶低氣壓沙德爾晚上8時位於本港東南約240公里；天文台指發出三號強風信號機會仍相對較低。

en.headline: Ombudsman finds 33,019 eTAX filings incomplete due to unclear wording
en.dek: Ambiguous instructions led many taxpayers to believe signing with iAM Smart finished the process; the Inland Revenue Department accepted 18 improvement recommendations.

zh.headline: 申訴專員：逾3.3萬人因提示不清未完成電子報稅
zh.dek: 公署指「稅務易」介面字句欠清晰，令不少人誤以為以「智方便」簽署即完成提交；稅務局接納全部18項改善建議。

en.headline: Rain and internet outages mark first day of Hong Kong robot convenience stores
en.dek: Three Galbot Stores staffed by humanoid robots opened in Hung Hom, Wan Chai and Kai Tak on Tuesday, drawing visitors despite technical hiccups and wet weather.

zh.headline: 全港首批機械人便利店首日遇雨及網絡故障
zh.dek: 銀河通用三間由人形機械人管理的Galbot Store周二於紅磡、灣仔及啟德開業，戶外店受大雨及網絡不穩影響，仍吸引市民到訪。

en.headline: Hong Kong man returned to Philippine prison after weather delays deportation
en.dek: Tang Lung-wai was taken back to maximum-security jail when a typhoon suspended immigration offices, his lawyer said, calling the delay illegal detention.

zh.headline: 港人鄧龍威菲國刑滿後因風球延誤遭送回監獄
zh.dek: 律師指颱風令入境部門暫停辦公，鄧龍威被送回最高設防監獄，並形容延誤屬非法羈留。

en.headline: M+ to open Herzog & de Meuron exhibition for fifth anniversary
en.dek: The West Kowloon museum said the Focus Gallery show, opening on 12 September, draws on a donation from the Swiss firm that designed the building.

zh.headline: M+五周年展出Herzog & de Meuron捐贈建築藏品
zh.dek: 西九M+博物館宣布，《Herzog & de Meuron：聚焦》將於9月12日在二樓焦點空間開幕，展出來自該館建築事務所的捐贈。

en.headline: New chronic hives drug approved under Hong Kong's '1+' scheme
en.dek: The Department of Health said a medicine for chronic spontaneous urticaria is the 22nd new drug registered since the streamlined mechanism began in 2023.

zh.headline: 「1+」機制再批新藥 慢性藻麻疹治療增至22款
zh.dek: 衞生署表示，一款用於慢性自發性藻麻疹的新藥已獲批准註冊，令「1+」機制下獲批新藥增至22款。

en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 to stay until at least 6pm as Saudel edges nearer
en.dek: The Observatory said Tropical Depression Saudel remains over the northern South China Sea and that the signal issued on Monday evening will stay in force through this afternoon.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號至少維持至下午六時 沙德爾靠近粵東沿岸
zh.dek: 天文台表示，熱帶低氣壓沙德爾仍在南海北部移動，昨晚發出的一號戒備信號會至少維持至今日下午六時。

en.headline: Hong Kong Watch and Clock Fair opens at the Convention Centre
en.dek: The Trade Development Council's 45th edition runs through Saturday at the Wan Chai venue, alongside Salon de TIME, and is open to trade visitors aged 18 or above.

zh.headline: 香港鐘表展今起於灣仔會展開鑾
zh.dek: 貿發局第四十五屆鐘表展舉行至周六，同期有國際名表蕃萃，實體展只開放予十八歲或以上業內人士。

en.headline: Sha Tin public housing tenant jailed six weeks over undeclared Tai Po flat
en.dek: The Housing Department said a Wo Che Estate resident who declared no Hong Kong property in 2025 in fact owned a home in Tai Po, and the public rental flat will be recovered.

zh.headline: 禾輏邸公屋戶隱瞞大埔物業 判監六星期單位將收回
zh.dek: 房屋署表示，該戶在二〇二五年申報表填報並無本港物業，其後被揭發當時持有大埔住宅，公屋單位將被收回。

en.headline: Health Department raids seven premises over unregistered cancer vaccine claims
en.dek: The Department of Health said a vaccine advertised as preventing multiple cancers is not a registered medicine in Hong Kong, and referred the case to Customs and the Medical Council.

zh.headline: 衞生署突擊巡查七處所 跟進未註冊防癌疫苗聲稱
zh.dek: 衞生署表示，有疫苗被宣傳可預防多種癌症，但並非本港註冊藥劑製品，個案已轉介海關及醫務委員會。

en.headline: CENTRESTAGE fashion fair opens at the Convention Centre from Wednesday
en.dek: The Trade Development Council said about 270 brands from 24 places will show through Saturday, with more than 30 runway presentations including an opening night for Kit Wan Studios.

zh.headline: 香港國際時尚匯展周三起於會展舉行
zh.dek: 貿發局表示約270個品牌來自24個國家及地區，展期至周六，並有逾30場時裝表演，開幕夜聚焦Kit Wan Studios。

en.headline: Theme park performer Bernice Yuen crowned Miss Hong Kong 2026
en.dek: The 26-year-old Baptist University graduate won Sunday night's TVB final at Tseung Kwan O, with Ada Tang and Scarlett Li named first and second runners-up.

zh.headline: 主題樂園演員袁絲珩當選2026香港小姐冠軍
zh.dek: 26歲浸大傳理系畢業生周日晚於將軍澳電視城奪冠，亞軍鄧匡閷、季軍李澤欣。

en.headline: WhatsApp hijacking scams jump 170 per cent in first seven months
en.dek: Police recorded 1,993 WhatsApp account-takeover cases from January to July, with losses of HK$146 million, and said phishing texts remain the main entry point.

zh.headline: 首七個月WhatsApp騎劫騙案升近一倍七 損失1.46億
zh.dek: 警方錄得1,993宗WhatsApp帳戶被騎劫個案，損失約1.46億元，指大部分仍由釣魚短訊入手。

en.headline: Retail sales rise 4.5 per cent in July, extending streak to 15 months
en.dek: Provisional Census and Statistics Department figures put July sales at HK$31 billion; jewellery and watches led the gain while motor vehicles and fuel fell.

zh.headline: 7月零售銷貨價值升4.5% 連續第15個月增長
zh.dek: 政府統計處臨時數字顯示7月零售銷貨約310億元；珠寶鐘錶升幅最大，汽車及燃料則下跌。

en.headline: Flu vaccination programmes start 17 September, a week earlier than last year
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said about 1.3 million doses have been procured for the 2026-27 season, with school outreach and public clinics opening as influenza remains active.

zh.headline: 季節性流感疫苗接種計劃9月17日展開 較去年提早一周
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心表示已採購約130萬劑疫苗供2026/27年度計劃使用，學校外展及公營診所同步開打，現時流感仍處高水平。

en.headline: Restaurant, Bar & Café Hong Kong trade show opens at HKCEC
en.dek: The three-day F&B expo runs until Thursday at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, featuring more than 400 exhibitors, coffee competitions and bar awards.

zh.headline: 香港餐飲展於會展開幕 展期至周四
zh.dek: 為期三天的餐飲貿易展於灣仔香港會議展覽中心舉行，匯聚逾400個參展商，設咖啡競賽及酒吧大獎。

en.headline: Nepalese bartenders pack Central bar for Nepal flood relief fundraiser
en.dek: About 100 patrons gathered at Orchard on Monday night as five Nepalese operators and staff served signature cocktails, with all sales going to the Nepal government’s disaster relief appeal.

zh.headline: 尼泊爾籍調酒師中環酒吧籌款 支援家鄉水災災民
zh.dek: 周一晚約百名顧客到中環Orchard，五名尼泊爾籍經營者及調酒師推出特色雞尾酒，全數收益捐予尼泊爾政府賑災。

en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 remains in force as Saudel tracks across northern South China Sea
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said the signal will stay until at least noon; Tropical Depression Saudel was about 400 kilometres south-southwest of the territory at 1am.

zh.headline: 沙德爾橫過南海北部 一號戒備信號繼續生效
zh.dek: 天文台指信號至少維持至中午；熱帶低氣壓沙德爾凌晨1時位於本港西南偏南約400公里。

en.headline: Margarita Mile cocktail trail returns across ten Hong Kong bars from today
en.dek: The two-week event runs until 16 September; participants collect stamps for El Tequileño margaritas, with a grand prize of a trip for two to Tequila, Mexico.

zh.headline: Margarita Mile雞尾酒巡禮今日起於十間酒吧舉行
zh.dek: 活動由今日至9月16日，集齊印章有機會贏取雙人墨西哥Tequila之旅，包括機票及酒莊參觀。

en.headline: Six bids received for inaugural land tender at Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and…
en.dek: Loop Hong Kong Park Company said the response for four parcels totalling more than 76,000 square metres of gross floor area exceeded expectations after the tender closed on Monday.

zh.headline: 港深創新及科技園首批地皮招標接獲六份標書
zh.dek: 落馬洲河套港方園區營運商表示，四幅合共樓面逾7.6萬平方米的地皮周一截標，反應較預期理想。

en.headline: Court of Appeal dismisses government bid to revive Fanling golf course housing plan
en.dek: Judges upheld a 2024 ruling that quashed environmental approval for 12,000 public flats on 9.5 hectares of the resumed site, citing unfair consultation and improper conditions.

zh.headline: 上訴庭駁回政府粉嶺高球場公屋計劃上訴
zh.dek: 三名法官維持2024年原審裁決，撤銷環評批准，指公眾諮詢不公及附加條件超出法定權限，涉及約12,000個公屋單位。

en.headline: Shein shares begin trading on Hong Kong exchange after $1.74 billion IPO
en.dek: The fast-fashion retailer priced 280 million shares at HK$48.56 each, valuing the company at about US$26.5 billion; public offering was 5.63 times subscribed.

zh.headline: Shein股份今日於港交所掛牌 集資約174億港元
zh.dek: 快時尚零售商以每股48.56港元發售2.8億股，集資約136億港元，估值約265億美元；公開發售超額認購5.63倍。

en.headline: Customs warns against XPower wireless power bank over burn risk
en.dek: Tests found the M10C+ model can overheat above 85 degrees Celsius when metal objects are placed between the charger and a device; 220 units were seized and sales banned.

zh.headline: 海關籲停用XPower無線尿袋 測出過熱燒傷風險
zh.dek: 測試顯示該款M10C+充電器在金屬外物夾於中間時溫度可達86.6至131.4度，超過限值；已檢獲220件並禁售。

en.headline: Tram service suspended between North Point and Happy Valley after power fault
en.dek: Westbound services from North Point Terminus to Tin Lok Lane were halted from about 6pm; eastbound services later resumed while engineers worked on the fault.

zh.headline: 北角至天樂里西行電車因電力故障暫停服務
zh.dek: 傍晚約6時起北角總站至天樂里（跑馬地圈）西行線電車暫停，東行線其後恢復，工程人員搶修。

en.headline: Wang Fuk Court buyout acceptance reaches 99.1 per cent as deadline ends
en.dek: By the 5pm Monday cut-off, 1,967 of 1,984 owners had returned acceptance letters, leaving 17 households; the government said it would press ahead with remaining acquisitions.

zh.headline: 宏福苑收購接受率達99.1% 限期屆滿尚餘17戶
zh.dek: 截至周一傍晚5時截止，1,984戶中有1,967戶交回接受書，比率99.1%；餘下17戶或面對強制收地。

en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 issued as Saudel becomes tropical depression
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the signal at 6.10pm after the remnant of the former typhoon intensified; it is expected to stay in force until at least noon on Tuesday.

zh.headline: 沙德爾增強為熱帶低氣壓 天文台發出一號戒備信號
zh.dek: 天文台傍晚6時10分因沙德爾殘餘增強為熱帶低氣壓而發出一號戒備信號，預料信號至少維持至周二中午。

en.headline: Grave of late actress Linda Lin Dai vandalised at Happy Valley cemetery
en.dek: Cemetery staff found graffiti and cement covering the marble altar of the four-time Asia Pacific Film Festival best actress; an 87-year-old man was arrested in connection with damage to a nearby grave.

zh.headline: 跑馬地林黛墳墓遭塗鴉及英泥覆蓋 87歲翁涉破壞鄰近墳墓被捕
zh.dek: 聖彌額爾天主教墳場發現四屆亞太影展影后林黛墓碑遭塗鴉，雲石拜台被英泥覆蓋；警方另就鄰近修會墳墓破壞拘捕一名退休男子。

en.headline: Hong Kong’s first fully autonomous robot retail stores open Tuesday
en.dek: Mainland firm Galbot launches three Galbot Store outlets at Hung Hom waterfront, Wan Chai waterfront and Kai Tak Sports Park, with Financial Secretary Paul Chan completing the first transaction at Kai Tak.

zh.headline: 本港首批全自主機械人零售店周二起營運
zh.dek: 內地具身智能企業銀河通用於紅磡海濱、灣仔海濱及啟德體育園開設三間Galbot Store，財政司司長陳茂波在啟德店完成首宗交易。

en.headline: ICAC, police and Competition Commission arrest 50 over building maintenance bid-rigging
en.dek: A joint operation codenamed Iron Alliance last week targeted a contractor-led syndicate linked to 27 estates and buildings, with contracts valued at nearly HK$500 million.

zh.headline: 廉署警方競委會聯手拘50人 打擊樓宇維修圍標集團
zh.dek: 代號「鐵盟」行動上週打擊以一間工程承辦商為首的貪污圍標集團，涉27個屋苑及大廈，合約總值近5億元。

en.headline: Two trucks collide on San Tin Highway; driver trapped briefly
en.dek: A 5.5-tonne lorry hit the rear of a 10-tonne lorry near Fairview Park shortly after 11am, leaving one driver with a trapped foot and another passenger with abrasions.

zh.headline: 新田公路兩貨車相撞 司機腳部被困一度救出
zh.dek: 上午11時22分近錦綉花園，一輛5.5噸貨車追撞前方10噸貨車，司機腳部被困，另一乘客擦傷，分別送院。

en.headline: Seasonal flu vaccination programmes start on 17 September
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said about 1.3 million doses have been procured for the 2026/27 programmes, with school outreach, residential care and subsidy schemes opening mid-month.

zh.headline: 2026/27季節性流感疫苗接種計劃9月17日展開
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心公布計劃包括學校外展、院舍及疫苗資助計劃，已採購約130萬劑疫苗，呼籲市民盡早接種。

en.headline: Observatory issues Amber Rainstorm Warning; thunderstorms until 3pm
en.dek: Heavy rain exceeding 30 mm an hour is expected to continue generally over Hong Kong after the signal was issued at 12.25pm, with the Thunderstorm Warning extended until 3pm.

zh.headline: 天文台發黃色暴雨警告 雷暴警告延至下午3時
zh.dek: 天文台下午12時25分發出黃色暴雨警告，預料廣泛地區每小時雨量超過30毫米；雷暴警告則延長至下午3時。

en.headline: Lawmaker urges source checks as dog abandonments rise
en.dek: Agriculture-sector legislator Chan Pok-chi said smugglers coach buyers to dodge quarantine, while a welfare group said intakes at one shelter rose at least 50 per cent.

zh.headline: 議員倡追截走私狗源頭 團體稱棄養個案升至少五成
zh.dek: 漁農界議員陳博智指有商人教買家規避檢疫；動物福利關注聯盟成員劉鎮海稱所屬機構近月接收棄養數字按月升至少五成。

en.headline: Transport Department warns of busier roads on first school day
en.dek: Rail, bus, ferry and taxi operators have been told to add services on Tuesday if needed, while the department's emergency centre will run at its highest tier.

zh.headline: 運輸署料開學日交通較繁忙 緊急中心明早最高級別運作
zh.dek: 署方已提醒鐵路、專營巴士、渡輪及的士提供充足服務，有需要時加密班次；緊急事故交通協調中心明早會以聯合督導模式運作。

en.headline: IVE stages three Hong Kong arena nights from Friday
en.dek: The South Korean group's Show What I Am world tour plays AsiaWorld-Arena on 4, 5 and 6 September, with an 8pm start on Friday and 6pm on the weekend.

zh.headline: IVE香港站周五起一連三場亞博Arena
zh.dek: 韓國組合IVE世界巡演《SHOW WHAT I AM》定於9月4至6日在亞洲國際博覽館Arena舉行，周五晚上8時、周末晚上6時開場。

en.headline: Think tank says more than a quarter of students want sports careers
en.dek: Our Hong Kong Foundation surveyed about 1,100 secondary pupils and called for dual-track school guidelines and clearer entry routes into the industry.

zh.headline: 團結香港基金：逾四分一中學生有意投身體育行業
zh.dek: 基金會訪問約1,100名中學生，指近半人不清楚入行途徑，建議為全港中學編制雙軌發展指引。

en.headline: Coleman Wong exits US Open after first-round loss to Tommy Paul
en.dek: The Hong Kong qualifier took the opening set in a tie-break on Louis Armstrong Stadium, then dropped the next three against the 20th seed.

zh.headline: 黃澤林美網男單首圈不敵保羅 先贏一盤後遭逆轉
zh.dek: 港將在路易斯阿姆斯壯球場搶七先下一城，其後連輸三盤，以盤數1比3止步20號種子。

en.headline: Observatory may issue Standby Signal as Saudel remnant rebuilds
en.dek: A special weather hint at 8.20am said the remnant of Tropical Cyclone Saudel may strengthen into a tropical depression near Hainan this evening.

zh.headline: 沙德爾殘餘料增強 天文台考慮黃昏前後發一號波
zh.dek: 天文台今早8時20分發特別天氣提示，指沙德爾殘餘黃昏前後移向海南島東南沿岸，並逐漸增強為熱帶低氣壓。
